description: This parser runs the same grammar with token-specific reductions and reductions allowed on every token.

steps.description: PROD stores numbered grammar productions. SHIFTS and GOTO provide shared shift and nonterminal transitions.
LR1 installs each reduction for one lookahead token. LR0 installs the same reductions for x, y, and end of input.
parse appends end of input, prints each stack and action, then shifts, reduces, accepts, or reports an error.
